title: Standing All Day
hook: What if you stand all day at work?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU STAND
ALL DAY?

beats.line: Your feet swell as fluid pools, looking puffy.
beats.idea: Close‑up of cartoon feet swelling, water droplets appear

beats.line: Your calf veins bulge, turning dark blue under pressure.
beats.idea: Calf side view shows prominent blue veins expanding

beats.line: Your lower back aches as spinal compression and muscle fatigue set in.
beats.idea: Character holds lower back, spine compresses, muscles show strain

beats.line: Your heart races, pumping blood upward against gravity's pull.
beats.idea: Heart graphic beats faster with arrows pointing upward

beats.line: A clot may form, raising deep‑vein thrombosis risk.
beats.idea: Close‑up of leg vein showing a red clot forming

description: A quick look at how standing all day impacts your body, from swollen feet to clot risk.

end.line: Would you still stand all day?

topic: What happens if you stand while working all day?
